scene_description: A family of four — an adult man, a teenage boy, and two young girls — sit around a fire pit at a campsite in the woods. They appear to be roasting marshmallows or sticks over the fire. A green tent and blue camping chairs are visible in the background.

questions.question: What do you see in the middle of the picture?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the round metal bowl in the middle of the picture.

questions.question: What are the people doing with their sticks?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the people's hands and what they are pointing toward the fire.

questions.question: Where are the people sitting?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the trees and ground around the people.

questions.question: What is the green thing behind the people?
questions.evidence_hint: Look behind the people on the right side of the picture.

questions.question: What might the people eat after they cook over the fire?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the sticks they are holding over the fire and think about what people cook at a campfire.

optional_extension_questions.question: Have you ever been camping or sat around a fire?
optional_extension_questions.evidence_hint: Think about a time you were outside with your family.
